description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 18.12.2023 to 24.12.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (P. B. S. C. Nonis), it does so only in the context of exercising statutory authority to issue regulatory instructions, not for personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
